pages.title: Letters From Below
pages.text: Decoding turns a random find into a route to a specific cave.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find cabins underground or via cartographer/mineshaft maps. Put tablet and paper in a Spelunkery Table and solve its three stages; use the resulting codex for a cave map. A codex also reveals entries in the cave book.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: A Flashier Flashlights battery stores FE. In inventory, carry a battery on the cursor and right-click the flashlight to insert one; right-click with an empty cursor to remove it. This applies when the current configuration requires a battery. An enabled light consumes charge once per second and

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: switches off when empty. A compatible FE charger uses the real item energy capability. A new battery without saved energy starts full. Capacity and drain come from configuration.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The flashlight follows your view: use the main hand and native toggle; stowing removes temporary light. Check the installed tooltip for battery/charge requirements. Client held-item lighting is not permanent base lighting.
